work: PRED-0016: Full-protocol (primaryOutcomes U secondaryOutcomes) sweat-chloride compartmentalization benchmark across locked early-phase PRISMA-included Cystic Fibrosis interventional trials from PRED-0015.

claims.statement: Among 54 locked early-phase non-healthy-volunteer PRISMA-included systemic CFTR modulator and systemic PTC readthrough trials, 35 (0.648148: 7 in primaryOutcomes and 28 added via secondaryOutcomes) register sweat chloride in outcomesModule measure strings.

methods.name: compiled regular-expression outcomesModule measure classifier

methods.name: regex-free character token-window measure scanner
methods.difference: separate file with zero re or math imports; scans lowercase alphanumeric token sequences

claims.statement: Among 15 pure airway-restricted early-phase CFTR-restoring genetic, mRNA, viral-vector, liposomal, and splice-ASO trials (and all 17 including dual-route NCT05668741 and NCT06237335), 0 (0.000000) register sweat chloride across primaryOutcomes or secondaryOutcomes measure strings.

methods.name: regex-free character token-window pure-inhaled scanner

claims.statement: Comparing 35/54 systemic vs 0/15 pure airway-restricted early-phase CFTR trials yields exact one-sided Fisher hypergeometric p = 15/4581527 (0.00000327), and comparing 35/54 vs 0/17 all-inhaled trials yields p = 270/325288417 (0.00000083).

methods.name: math.comb hypergeometric support summation

methods.name: multiplicative Fraction product summation

claims.statement: On 35/54 systemic vs 0/15 pure airway-restricted early-phase CFTR trials (risk difference +0.648148), the Chan-Zhang unconditional 95% CI is [0.383804, 0.776095] and the Newcombe-Wilson Method-10 95% CI is [0.404556, 0.761770].

methods.name: Cardano trigonometric restricted-MLE + golden-section Chan-Zhang CI95 lower bound

methods.name: 50-digit Decimal polynomial-bisection + ternary Chan-Zhang CI95 lower bound
methods.difference: solves Miettinen-Nurminen score polynomial by monotone bisection and 50-digit Decimal ternary refinement without math

claims.statement: Pre-registered PRED-0016 hypothesis is supported on measured ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 outcomesModule records across the locked 71 early-phase CFTR trials: adding secondaryOutcomes resolves PRED-0015's primary-only censoring (7/54 -> 35/54 systemic vs 0/15 pure-inhaled and 0/17 all-inhaled; p_fisher_pure_1s = 15/4581527 = 0.00000327 < 0.01; Chan-Zhang 95% CI [0.383804, 0.776095]; Newcombe-Wilson 95% CI [0.404556, 0.761770]).
